questions.question: What is meant by sexual division of labour?
options: Division of work according to age
Division of work between men and women based on gender
Division of work according to income
Division of work according to education

questions.question: Which of the following is traditionally considered “women’s work”?
Which Act attempted to address wage inequality in India?
What is meant by “invisible unpaid labour”?
options: Unpaid work that is essential but often not recognized as work

questions.question: Which term describes the difficulty women face in reaching higher professional positions?
What is the “mommy track”?
options: A career path for mothers with faster promotions
Slower career advancement because of childcare responsibilities

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of housework?
Why is housework called “invisible labour”?
options: It is usually unpaid and often goes unnoticed
It is performed outside the home

questions.question: Who wrote the essay I Want a Wife?
What is the main message of I Want a Wife?
options: Women should only work at home
Marriage should involve equality and shared responsibilities
Men should do all household work

questions.question: Who wrote Vantillu (The Kitchen)?
In Vantillu, the kitchen mainly symbolizes:
options: Women’s unpaid labour and loss of freedom

questions.question: According to the material, approximately how many hours do Indian women spend on household work daily?
Approximately how much time do Indian men spend on household work daily?
The “Share the Load” campaign emphasizes:
options: Women should do all household work

questions.question: Which Constitutional Amendments provided reservations for women in elected bodies?
Who was the woman who became the first woman driver in the Delhi Transport Corporation?
What are the three major types of women’s work discussed in the chapter?
options: Unpaid family work, home-based work and housework

questions.question: Why was Sayamma officially classified as a “non-worker”?
options: She did not earn a regular income

questions.question: What is the central idea of the unit Gender and Labour?
options: Women should focus only on household work
Women’s work has economic and social value and should be recognized
Domestic work has no economic value
